name: genie-control-tower-control-tower-qa
description: Browser-driven QA harnesses. Kept out of app/frontend on purpose: puppeteer is test tooling, not an app dependency, and vendoring it there put a 200MB browser download in the deployed bundle's dependency tree. Node resolves an ESM import from the importing FILE's directory upward, so these scripts need a node_modules beside them, not one beside the app.
